name: Tidal Falls
author: Tiedeyez
description: Over the bar the river leans, / a lip of light, a breath, a fall; / in ragged bands of sapphire blue / it quickens down the pixel wall. / The pool below throws silver spray, / the mist climbs slow on morning air, / and from the veil a name comes up, / wet stone that was not always there. / It holds a while, then washes clear, / and still the falling water sings: / sixteen bits of endless blue / above the work your morning brings.
